The formula of ammonia is NH3.
Which statement about a molecule of ammonia is correct?
A
The bonding in a molecule of ammonia is ionic.
B
The nitrogen atom has a noble gas configuration; the hydrogen atoms do not.
C
The nitrogen atom shares all of its electrons with the hydrogen atoms.
D
There are six shared electrons in a molecule of ammonia.
